以下可以在LINUX上操作完复制出来.源内就有CMAKE文件了
git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s
cd openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s
git checkout OpenSSL_1_1_1s
git clone https://github.com/devolutions/openssl-cmake.git
git -C openssl-cmake checkout-index -a -f --prefix=./


//加入项目

openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s\CMakeLists.txt
openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s\crypto\CMakeLists.txt
openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s\ssl\CMakeLists.txt
openssl-OpenSSL_1_1_1s\apps\CMakeLists.txt

${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}， 改成 ${OPENSSL_SRC_DIR}。

curl cmake部分
注释这个 find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto
替换为实际生成的名字ssl crypto
